rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for meaning completely or to the full extent.

example.english: This plan entirely changed our lives.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃完全改變咗我哋嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jyun4 cyun4 goi2 bin3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when entirely means only or solely, excluding everyone or everything else.

example.english: This offer is entirely for members.
example.traditional: 呢個優惠淨係會員有份。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 zing6 hai6 wui6 jyun4 jau5 fan6
